assets.name: Clear tape
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one draggable scrapbook sticker for the Strip app. Create a single short horizontal piece of clear translucent sticky tape, torn unevenly at both ends, gently crinkled with realistic adhesive texture and restrained glossy highlights. Flat overhead scanned-object photography, tactile, playful Y2K-adjacent not futuristic, slightly bright exposure, authentic imperfect material, sharp complete cutout. Entire object visible, centered, almost fills the canvas with a small clear margin, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. No text, letters, logos, border, white sticker outline, hands, tape roll, other objects or cast shadow. Single separate piece only.
